$schema.title: /$schema
$schema.description: Specifies the type of this file

clock-format.title: /ui/clock-format
clock-format.description: The format for the clock displayed in the top-left corner using strftime(3) conversions

dim-text.title: /ui/dim-text
dim-text.description: Reduce the brightness of text (useful for xterms). This setting can be useful when running in an xterm where the white color is very bright.

default-colors.title: /ui/default-colors
default-colors.description: Use default terminal background and foreground colors instead of black and white for all text coloring.  This setting can be useful when transparent background or alternate color theme terminal is used.

keymap.title: /ui/keymap
keymap.description: The name of the keymap to use.

theme.title: /ui/theme
theme.description: The name of the theme to use.

vars.description: Variables definitions3 that are used in this theme.
vars.title: /ui/theme-defs/<theme_name>/vars

alt-text.description: Styling for plain text when alternating
alt-text.title: /ui/theme-defs/<theme_name>/styles/alt-text

hidden.description: Styling for hidden fields in logs
hidden.title: /ui/theme-defs/<theme_name>/styles/hidden

adjusted-time.description: Styling for timestamps that have been adjusted
adjusted-time.title: /ui/theme-defs/<theme_name>/styles/adjusted-time

syntax-styles.description: Styles for syntax highlighting in text files.
syntax-styles.title: /ui/theme-defs/<theme_name>/syntax-styles

keyword.description: Styling for keywords in source files
keyword.title: /ui/theme-defs/<theme_name>/syntax-styles/keyword

string.description: Styling for single/double-quoted strings in text
string.title: /ui/theme-defs/<theme_name>/syntax-styles/string

comment.description: Styling for comments in source files
comment.title: /ui/theme-defs/<theme_name>/syntax-styles/comment

symbol.description: Styling for symbols in source files
symbol.title: /ui/theme-defs/<theme_name>/syntax-styles/symbol

number.description: Styling for numbers in source files
number.title: /ui/theme-defs/<theme_name>/syntax-styles/number

re-special.description: Styling for special characters in regular expressions
re-special.title: /ui/theme-defs/<theme_name>/syntax-styles/re-special

re-repeat.description: Styling for repeats in regular expressions
re-repeat.title: /ui/theme-defs/<theme_name>/syntax-styles/re-repeat

diff-delete.description: Styling for deleted lines in diffs
diff-delete.title: /ui/theme-defs/<theme_name>/syntax-styles/diff-delete

diff-add.description: Styling for added lines in diffs
diff-add.title: /ui/theme-defs/<theme_name>/syntax-styles/diff-add

file.description: Styling for file names in source files
file.title: /ui/theme-defs/<theme_name>/syntax-styles/file

warn.description: Styling for warnings in status bars
warn.title: /ui/theme-defs/<theme_name>/status-styles/warn

alert.description: Styling for alerts in status bars
alert.title: /ui/theme-defs/<theme_name>/status-styles/alert

active.description: Styling for activity in status bars
active.title: /ui/theme-defs/<theme_name>/status-styles/active

title.description: Styling for title sections of status bars
title.title: /ui/theme-defs/<theme_name>/status-styles/title

subtitle.description: Styling for subtitle sections of status bars
subtitle.title: /ui/theme-defs/<theme_name>/status-styles/subtitle

log-level-styles.description: Styles for each log message level.
log-level-styles.title: /ui/theme-defs/<theme_name>/log-level-styles

((?:x[0-9a-f]{2})+).description: The hexadecimal encoding of key codes to map to a command.
((?:x[0-9a-f]{2})+).title: /ui/keymap-defs/<keymap_name>/<key_seq>

command.title: /ui/keymap-defs/<keymap_name>/<key_seq>/command
command.description: The command to execute for the given key sequence.

alt-msg.title: /ui/keymap-defs/<keymap_name>/<key_seq>/alt-msg
alt-msg.description: The help message to display after the key is pressed.

(\\w+).title: /global/<var_name>
(\\w+).description: A global variable definition.  Global variables can be referenced in scripts, SQL statements, or commands.

color.title: /color
color.description: The foreground color value for this style. The value can be the name of an xterm color, the hexadecimal value, or a theme variable reference.

background-color.title: /background-color
background-color.description: The foreground color value for this style. The value can be the name of an xterm color, the hexadecimal value, or a theme variable reference.

underline.title: /underline
underline.description: Indicates that the text should be underlined.

bold.title: /bold
bold.description: Indicates that the text should be bolded.
